text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the day of the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With her resolve to keep up with Mihono Bourbon hardened, Rice Shower enters the starting gate.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Then… over the many voices in the crowd, the signal sounds, marking the beginning of the Kikuka Sho.
